description: Returns owner-only cookieless counts for a slug: views per UTC day, top paths, top referrer hosts, and AI crawler counts by user-agent family. Inputs: slug, optional from and to as YYYY-MM-DD (default the last 7 days, maximum 90), and token. The accuracy field describes under-counting. No raw IP or full user agent is stored.

from.description: First UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default is 6 days before to.

to.description: Last UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default is today.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

name: site_analytics
title: Site analytics
